name: Closest Point Propagation
aliases: Closest Point Propagation for Signed-Distance Volumes
Closest Point Propagation — Distance Transform via FIFO Queue
definition: An algorithm to compute a signed distance volume by propagating closest-point information from an initialized zero set to the rest of the volume using a heuristic that neighbors share similar closest points.
summary: Closest Point Propagation computes signed distance fields and closest surface points via a single-pass FIFO queue, distinguishing itself by explicitly tracking 3D coordinates for accurate reconstruction.
